# Cam Dyer (Camron Dyer) — Basketball

> Camron "Cam" Dyer is a 6'5" guard/forward from Rochester, New York, and a 2026–27 senior at SUNY Brockport (NCAA Division III, Empire 8 Conference), #8. Pro basketball prospect available to sign with a professional club in June 2027. Available for workouts, tryouts and exposure events in Buffalo, Rochester, Albany, New York City and overseas.

## Key facts
- Position: Guard / Forward. Height: 6'5". Hometown: Rochester, NY.
- Path: Uprep (Rochester) → AAU in Las Vegas → Dixie High School (St. George, UT) → Red Rock Academy post-grad (Las Vegas) → SUNY Niagara (2023–25, NJCAA) → SUNY Brockport (2025–27, NCAA D-III).
- Stats: 8.0 PPG (2023–24, SUNY Niagara); 10.3 PPG (2024–25, SUNY Niagara); 11.7 PPG, 5.0 RPG, 2.1 APG, 1.5 SPG (2025–26, SUNY Brockport). 970+ career college points, approaching 1,000 in 2026–27.
- Honors: Third Team All-Empire 8 (2025–26); NJCAA Region III Division II champion (2025), started all 34 games; NJCAA DII national tournament qualifier (2025); Eurobasket Tours Empire 8 team, playing pro clubs in Lisbon and Porto, Portugal (June 1–10, 2027).
- Contact: contact form at https://camrondyer.com/#feedback, or Instagram @whytheyhatec.
